selection.purpose: Experimental full-body floor-to-shoulder hoist. Knees and hips lower, both hands gather the body, legs drive the lift and the shoulder settles under the load. Native target shapes are blended along an authored path. This is a visual feasibility candidate: contacts, body collision, weight, equipment transitions and native NPC ownership remain unverified.
